verified: CMSA named Tang Hongbo, Wu Yi and Muhammad Zeeshan Ali as the Shenzhou-24 crew at a pre-launch news conference, and the Chang Zheng 2F/G carrying the spacecraft rolled out to Site 91 on Nov. 17; Tiangong adjusted its orbit on Nov. 23 ahead of the arrival.
unconfirmed: The Nov. 25 launch time is a target — the report says "no earlier than" — and Ali's roughly one-week stay, the docking time and his return date are mission plans rather than flown results; no independent confirmation of the schedule is given.

verified: 据 NASASpaceflight 报道，中国载人航天工程办公室公布了神舟二十四号乘组名单，任务计划不早于11月25日00:18 UTC从酒泉发射；阿里是载荷专家，驻留约一周后乘神舟二十三号返回。
unconfirmed: 发射是否按时进行、交会对接与驻留是否成功、阿里是否完成中巴实验，以及“首位外籍航天员进入天宫”能否成为既成事实；报道未披露具体实验清单和成果，也没有独立于中方安排的任务结果。

titles.en: Shenzhou-24 set to carry first Pakistani astronaut to Tiangong
titles.zh: 神舟二十四号将送巴基斯坦航天员首访天宫
